{{Youmay|the building|[[Kebla Yurt]]}}
A '''yurt''' was a type of building that many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] chose to build for themselves to live in.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Wikipedia:yurt|yurt]] is a traditional style of tent dwelling used by the nomadic peoples of the Asian steppes, also known as ''ger''.
